crossRefs.note: When all the people saw it, they fell on their faces. They said, “Yahweh, he is God! Yahweh, he is God!”
Elijah said to them, “Seize the prophets of Baal! Don’t let one of them escape!” They seized them; and Elijah brought…
He went after the man of Israel into the pavilion, and thrust both of them through, the man of Israel, and the woman…
They buried the bones of Saul and Jonathan his son in the country of Benjamin in Zela, in the tomb of Kish his father…
After these things, Naboth the Jezreelite had a vineyard, which was in Jezreel, next to the palace of Ahab king of…
Yahweh also spoke of Jezebel, saying, “The dogs will eat Jezebel by the rampart of Jezreel.
Their border was to Jezreel, Chesulloth, Shunem,
and he made him king over Gilead, and over the Ashurites, and over Jezreel, and over Ephraim, and over Benjamin, and…
So Jehu rode in a chariot and went to Jezreel, for Joram lay there. Ahaziah king of Judah had come down to see Joram.

people.name: Ahab
people.line: Wicked king of Israel; husband of Jezebel

people.name: Jezreel
people.line: A city in Issachar, associated with Ahab and Jezebel

translations.web: In a little while, the sky grew black with clouds and wind, and there was a great rain. Ahab rode, and went to Jezreel.
translations.bsb: Meanwhile, the sky grew dark with clouds and wind, and a heavy rain began to fall. So Ahab rode away and went to Jezreel.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass in the mean while, that the heaven was black with clouds and wind, and there was a great rain. And Ahab rode, and went to Jezreel.
translations.asv: And it came to pass in a little while, that the heavens grew black with clouds and wind, and there was a great rain. And Ahab rode, and went to Jezreel:
